'''Phinda resin''' was a substance procured from the secretions of the [[Phidna/Legends|Phidna]] which was highly explosive in its raw form.<ref>[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]</ref> [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] hives harvested it underground as of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. It could be identified by its distinctive smell alone.
